## 型

### Platform

```emela
layer Platform { SystemConsole, SystemClock, SystemRandom, SystemHttp }
uses { Async }
```

The System handlers that every host has: SystemConsole, SystemClock, SystemRandom and
SystemHttp. Requires no host effect other than Async. To replace some of them, list the
replacements after it, as in `with Platform, TestClock { ... }`.
